Mr Jones Watches

1 model on WRotate · 3 members own one

Mr Jones Watches is a London-based watch brand known for its playful and unconventional timepieces that prioritize storytelling and artistic expression over simple time-telling. The brand collaborates with various artists and designers to create unique, conversation-starting watches.

The story

Founded by Crispin Jones in London in 2007, the brand emerged from the idea that in an age where everyone checks their phone for the time, a watch can be a more expressive and playful object. Initially, Jones designed all the watches himself, with early designs focused on questioning the function of a watch and often featuring memento mori themes. The brand's approach shifted to collaborating with artists and designers to create limited-edition, story-rich timepieces. In 2011, the company moved its assembly and printing in-house to a London workshop to have more control over production and the creative process. This move allowed for a faster turnaround from concept to finished product. Mr Jones Watches has since grown, opening a shop in Covent Garden and continuing to produce all its watches in its London workshops. One of its well-known designs is "A Perfectly Useless Afternoon," created in collaboration with Belgian illustrator Kristof Devos. This watch, which features a lounging figure in a pool to mark the hours and a floating duck for the minutes, embodies the brand's philosophy of encouraging a more relaxed relationship with time. Today, Mr Jones Watches continues to be a small, independent brand focused on producing distinctive, wearable art.
